meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 通过 Chat SDK 为应用接入 Google Chat 渠道。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发应用并想让它能收发 Google Chat 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add Google Chat integration to your app via the Chat SDK.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app and need Google Chat messaging.

howto.what: Claude 会把 Google Chat 适配器复制进项目并注册，安装固定版本依赖，再执行构建和集成测试。待人工配好 Google Cloud 凭据与公网 webhook 后，程序就能在 Google Chat 空间收发消息。
howto.when: 用户要求把 Google Chat 加入为聊天频道，或要求按 add-gchat 技能配置 Google Chat 集成时。

say.text: 帮我接入 Google Chat 频道
say.note: Claude 会开始执行适配器复制与注册。

say.text: 给这个项目加一个 Google Chat 通道
say.note: 它会安装依赖并跑构建与集成测试。

say.text: 把 Google Chat 设为 NanoClaw 的一个频道
say.note: 还需要按提示配 Google Cloud 凭据。

howto.what_en: Claude copies and registers the Google Chat adapter, installs the pinned dependency, builds, and runs one integration test. Once credentials and a public webhook are set up, the app can send/receive messages in Google Chat.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to add Google Chat as a chat channel or to configure this Google Chat integration.

say_en.text: Add Google Chat as a channel
say_en.note: Claude starts copying and registering the adapter.

say_en.text: Add a Google Chat channel to this project
say_en.note: It installs dependencies and runs build plus tests.

say_en.text: Make Google Chat one of NanoClaw's channels
say_en.note: Google Cloud credentials still need to be filled in.
